summary: Independent Studio One reference for the maintained, MIT-licensed go-chi/chi library, generated by Sourcey from a pinned upstream checkout.

observations.subject: source
observations.detail: The actual upstream checkout at the pinned commit supplied both public packages and 35 Go source files. The reference retains upstream's copyright and MIT license.

observations.subject: maintenance
observations.detail: Upstream commit 756fcb8d630fc10c53e2cc0f824c3b53112a6cba, dated 2026-08-31, raised the minimum supported Go version to 1.24. The extraction uses a later pinned commit; this is not represented as a tagged release.

observations.subject: adapter
observations.detail: Sourcey 3.6.5 native godoc adapter. The sourcey-godoc schema_version 1 snapshot is generated from actual Go source and consumed with mode=snapshot.

observations.subject: extraction
observations.path_note: Workstation paths are redacted; snapshot_sha256 binds the unmodified output.
observations.result: Sourcey: wrote godoc snapshot for github.com/go-chi/chi/v5; Packages: 2. The snapshot was copied without modification into docs/chi/godoc.json.

observations.subject: build
observations.result: Sourcey generated 3 navigable HTML pages, a search index, styles, client search, sitemap, llms.txt and llms-full.txt.

observations.subject: coverage
observations.detail: 56 package functions, 20 types and 45 methods are extracted across chi and middleware. These are source declarations, not invented endpoints or prose headings.

observations.subject: example-gap
observations.detail: There are zero extracted Example entries. The standalone upstream _examples programs are outside normal go list traversal; the usage guide links to the pinned examples and states this limitation.

observations.subject: upstream-tests
observations.result: Both public packages passed their tests. go vet completed successfully.

observations.subject: publication-home
observations.detail: Studio One is an existing software development organization site with published web-app, API and developer-tool projects. This independent reference is linked from its footer and explicitly attributes chi to its upstream maintainers.
